pages.title: About VIEW Group - VIEW Group Norway
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Accelerate Your Growth with Finance and IT Outsourcing Solutions
Focus on what you do best and let us handle the rest. Our comprehensive finance, payroll, and IT outsourcing services are designed to strengthen your core business operations. In addition, you gain total control over your financial data with efficient ERP-systems, empowering you to make informed decisions to accelerate your business.
Accountancy
Experienced consultants with extensive financial expertise
Choose the level of support your business needs from our wide range of accountancy services. From day-to-day bookkeeping to annual accounts, financial reporting, analysis and advisory support.
Payroll
Qualified payroll specialists experienced in pay and benefits regulations
Get control and get it right. When you need cost-effective, accurate and fully managed payroll services, our dedicated payroll consultants act as your own payroll team, freeing up time and reducing vulnerability caused by a lack of resources or knowledge.
System Solutions
Smart ERP systems and BI tools for efficient processes and data control
Strengthen your decision-making with the right business system solutions providing you with essential data and information. Our experienced ERP consultants will guide you from initial consultation to implementation and ongoing optimisation.
IT Services
IT and Telephony services tailored to your specific business needs
Keep your business operations running smoothly and up-to-date with IT outsourcing solutions focused on efficiency and security. Our dedicated and skilled consultants will help you choose the right solution for your organisation and your ambitions.

Qualified payroll specialists experienced in pay and benefits regulations

Strengthen your decision-making with the right business system solutions providing you with essential data and information. Our experienced ERP consultants will guide you from initial consultation to implementation and ongoing optimisation.
IT and Telephony services tailored to your specific business needs
Keep your business operations running smoothly and up-to-date with IT outsourcing solutions focused on efficiency and security. Our dedicated and skilled consultants will help you choose the right solution for your organisation and your ambitions.
About VIEW Group
We enable businesses to succeed through insight and technology. With our support and advice, our clients can turn their numbers into action and make the decisions that allow them to grow and prosper.
Our future-proof all-in-one solutions for your key support services enable you to unlock the full potential of your business. We offer comprehensive finance, payroll, IT and telephony outsourcing, enhanced by sophisticated ERP systems and BI solutions.
Your financial data tells the story of your organisation and provides key insights on how to run it more efficiently and profitably. Whether it’s forecasting cash flow or managing user licences, we uncover the story behind your numbers and help you make sense of them to grow your business.
From 3 brothers in Norway to 1100+ experts in 5 countries
VIEW Group was founded in 2004 under the name VIEW Ledger by three brothers in Norway. Right from the start, the goal was clear: to transform the accounting industry by digitalising and automating a rather traditional business function.
Today, we are a trusted partner within finance and accountech, operating in the Nordics, UK, and India. Our more than 1100 employees specialises in various areas of finance, payroll, system solutions, IT, and telephony. Our clients benefit from our collective expertise and best practices across a wide range of industries.
Advantages of choosing VIEW Group
Unique combination of highly skilled consultants
We provide specialist expertise in finance, payroll and IT – areas where we see great potential for synergies through collaboration. From full-service outsourcing solutions to assisting internal departments or management teams, we are ready to support your business needs.
Scalable solutions to suit your business growth
Supporting your business success is our top priority. You won’t experience any growing pains here. You’ll have access to advisory, system solutions and IT services that are precisely tailored to your business needs.
Cutting-edge technology to enable your progress
You can rest assured that our technology solutions are designed to operate seamles

pages.title: Nydalen - VIEW Group Norway
pages.main_text_excerpt:
VIEW Group Nydalen
VIEW Group er et kompetansehus med økonomer, lønnsspesialister, teknologer og IT – folk som hjelper små og store selskap med regnskap og forretningsinnsikt. Vi jobber hver dag for å gi våre kunder smarte løsninger i ERP-systemet og god oversikt over tallene. Vi tilbyr alltid fastpris og fleksible løsninger til deg som ønsker å vokse.
Din regnskapsfører i Nydalen
Hos oss får du personlig og engasjert service – uansett om du ønsker hjelp til regnskap, lønnstjenester eller smarte digitale løsninger. Våre eksperter har bred kompetanse innen økonomi og HR og lang erfaring med å hjelpe bedrifter i ulike bransjer med å få tak i tallene og vokse. Ta kontakt så forteller vi deg mer!
Regnskap
Regnskap og rapportering
Hos oss får du alltid fastpris på regnskapstjenester, inkludert systemer som gir deg god oversikt. Vi tar oss selvfølgelig av rapportering til myndighetene og skreddersyr egne rapporter til ledere i din bedrift. Du slipper å tenke på frister og mva, men får tilgang til oppdaterte regnskapstall on the fly.
Kontakt oss for å se din fastpris på regnskap!
Lønnstjenester
Lønnstjenester – ved behov eller fastpris
Hos VIEW Group kan du outsource deler eller hele lønnsavdelingen din. Vi tilbyr lønnstjenester for selskaper med opptil 5000 ansatte.
Våre tjenester omfatter lønnskjøring, rapportering, personaladministrasjon og bedriftsportaler.
Vi kan reduserer din sårbarheten ved sykdom og øker fleksibiliteten i leveransen.
System / ERP
System og ERP leveranse
Vi leverer skreddersydde økonomiløsninger, BI og AI, styreportal, app for reise og utlegg, samt integrasjoner mellom andre fagsystemer.
Vårt team skaper skreddersydde integrasjoner som sikrer effektivitet og smidig samhandling mellom systemene dine, og bidrar til å optimalisere forretningsprosesser.
IT tjenester
Din IT-tjenesteleverandør
Vi tilbyr et bredt utvalg av IT-tjenester tilpasset dine behov. Våre tjenester inkluderer skytjenester, IT-drift, infrastruktur, sikkerhet, rådgivning, printtjenester og møteromsløsninger.
Målet vårt er å utvikle og forbedre din digitale arbeidsplass.
